title: Third Shot Drop Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 130bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Kitchen line is seven feet
Net eleven inches above
Arc is the answer
Soft is the way

[Whisper verse]
Feet stop before the swing
Knees bend low to the ground
Paddle face open thirty degrees
Grip pressure three out of ten

Contact in front of the body
Lift from the legs not the arm
Shoulder swings the paddle
Wrist stays neutral

[Tribal drop chant]
Drop the ball drop the ball
Arc the ball arc the ball
Suave suave pa lante
Drop the ball arc the ball

[Whisper verse]
Landing zone the kitchen
Apex above the net
Slow speed off the face
Low bounce on their side

Follow through to the sky
Return to ready slow
Walk to the line don't run
Breath out and reset

[Tribal drop chant]
Drop the ball drop the ball
Arc the ball arc the ball
Suave suave pa lante
Drop the ball arc the ball

[Whisper outro]
Soft hands
Slow arc
Soft hands
Slow arc
